items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: They were with us, and they did a couple of recordings with us... we did some theater tours

ctx.x: So Lunceford had an abundance of guys doing things of this sort, and it was a good entertaining band, and this counted a lot, you know, with people, because visually they were good, and the band played good, you know.

They were with us, and they did a couple of recordings with us, and I can't remember the year, but I know it was in the late '30's or the early '40's, and they -- we did some theater tours, and they looked good on the stage, you know, and Dorothy and her sister Vivian, and the with them other girl was not a sister. Her name was Etta Jones. And she later married Gerald Wilson. This was Gerald's first wife -- the arranger on the West Coast.
